g.text: Grid coupling and gear coupling are used for different purposes

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: in Grid coupling you see, the main motor is rotating at very high

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: speeds, Grid coupling is used where the main motive is to transfer

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji
Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: however after main reducer, the speed gets drastically reduced and

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: that gets traded off to Torque, now here hence we use Gear coupling

text.font-family: Excalifont, Xiaolai, sans-serif, Segoe UI Emoji

g.text: where this is more effective and can bear great torque transfer.
What a Grid Coupling is good at
A grid coupling uses a spring-like steel grid between two hubs
The flexible grid acts like a spring and protects both the motor and gearbox.
What a Gear Coupling is good at
A gear coupling consists of external and internal gear teeth that mesh together.
Very high torque capacity for its size
Shock loads from the driven machine may be significant
Gear couplings are mechanically strong and can transmit enormous torque without requiring a very large coupling size.
